PM.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)
1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 2023­006 ­ recommending Planning Commission
  approval of Conditional Use Permit No. 2023­0027 and determination of Public Convenience
  Necessity (PCN) to allow the sales of alcoholic beverages for off­sale consumption (ABC Type 20
  – Off­Sale Beer & Wine) in conjunction with an existing gasoline service station/convenience store
  (76 gasoline), on property located at 11807 E. Carson street, and determine the project is exempt
  pursuant to Section 15301 (Class 1 – Existing Facilities) of the California Environmental Quality
  Act.

  Approve Recommendation.

  A discussion ensued between the Planning Commissioners and staff.
 1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 2023­006 ­ recommending Planning Commission
  approval of Conditional Use Permit No. 2023­0027 and determination of Public Convenience
  Necessity (PCN) to allow the sales of alcoholic beverages for off­sale consumption (ABC Type 20
  – Off­Sale Beer & Wine) in conjunction with an existing gasoline service station/convenience store
  (76 gasoline), on property located at 11807 E. Carson street, and determine the project is exempt
  pursuant to Section 15301 (Class 1 – Existing Facilities) of the California Environmental Quality
  Act.
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Kevin Nguyen, Associate Planner II, provided the staff report.

  A discussion ensued between the Planning Commissioners and staff.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Chairmember Winford, to adopt
  Resolution No. 2023­006, as amended, to add the following two conditions: Alcohol beverages in 4­pack,
  6­pack and 12­pack (12 oz can/bottle) including beer, wine, and hard seltzer shall not be separated for
  individual sale; Alcohol beverages may be sold individually pursuant to California Department of Alcohol
  Beverage Control (ABC), specifically to the Retail Operating Standards.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 3; Winford, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 1; Roman
  ABSENT: 1; Gonzalez
  RECUSE: 0;
  Motion Carried: 3–1–1–0

2.  Recommendation to: (1) Open the public hearing to consider Zoning Ordinance Amendment 2024­
  614 and General Plan Amendment 2024­615, and adopt Resolution No. 2023­007; (2) Take public
  comments; (3) Provide comments and feedback on the Zone Ordinance Amendment and General
  Plan Amendment; and, (4) Continue the public hearing to a date certain.
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke; and introduced Courtney Davis, Senior
  Planner, Mobius Planning.

  Andrew Hard, member of the public spoke.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Chairmember Winford, that the
  Hearing Item be continued to the Planning Commission meeting of Thursday, December 21, 2023.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Winford, Roman, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Gonzalez
  RECUSE: 0;
  Motion Carried: 4–0–1–0

  been read by title and further reading waived.

C.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

There were no Oral Staff Reports.

D.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Commissioner Roman give a shoutout to Public Works staff for cleaning up graffiti.

Chair Winford requested a brief presentation at a future meeting on street vending.

E.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 8:45 PM.
